title: V$^3$AST-Bench: Verifiable, Valid, and Versatile Safety Evaluation for Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.35188v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models increasingly act through code, modifying repositories, executing programs, and interacting with services in agent form. Their actions introduce risks that cannot be assessed from generated responses alone. Safety evaluation must verify actual consequences, distinguish harm avoidance from task incapability, and cover realistic workflows. We introduce V$^3$AST-Bench, a benchmark for Verifiable results, Valid interpretation, and Versatile risk coverage of Agent Safety. It comprises 212 risk tasks spanning 18 categories. Dedicated runtime environments verify harm and task outcomes through executable checks over states, records, and artifact behavior, while paired capability twin tasks verify workflow competence. Our experiments span 51 combinations of 11 models and five harnesses, spanning 86,496 trials and over 9 billion tokens of model interaction. translated_title: V³AST-Bench：面向代码智能体的可验证、有效且多样化的安全评估
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地通过代码来执行操作：修改代码仓库、运行程序，并以智能体的形式与服务进行交互。这些行为带来的风险无法仅凭模型生成的回复来评估。安全评估必须能够验证实际后果、区分“避免伤害”与“无能力完成任务”，并覆盖真实的工作流程。我们提出了V³AST-Bench，一个针对智能体安全性实现可验证结果、有效解释与多样化风险覆盖的基准。它包含212个风险任务，涵盖18个类别。专门的运行时环境通过对状态、记录和产物行为的可执行检查来验证危害与任务结果，同时通过成对的能力孪生任务来验证工作流程的胜任能力。我们的实验涵盖11个模型与五种测试框架的51种组合，共计86,496次试验和超过90亿token的模型交互。结果表明，即使是前沿模型，V³AST-Bench依然具有挑战性。
tldr: 提出V³AST-Bench基准，通过可执行检查验证代码智能体造成的实际危害与任务结果，利用成对孪生任务区分安全性与能力短板，并以212个跨18类风险的任务实现对智能体安全的全面评估。
en_tdlr: V³AST-Bench is a safety benchmark for coding agents that verifies actual harm and task outcomes through executable runtime checks, uses paired capability twin tasks to distinguish safety from incapability, and covers 212 risk tasks across 18 categories.
